author: Sam — Robot Hand Integration and Manipulation
purpose: mount load vs grip and drop check
code_or_query:
area_m2=15e-3*20e-3
Fmax=139.0
Fgrip=30.0
p_max=Fmax/area_m2
p_grip=Fgrip/area_m2
# friction hold for 1kg object: need mu*F_grip*2 fingers >= m*(g+a) with a=5 m/s2
m=1.0; g=9.81; a=5.0
F_needed=m*(g+a)/(2*0.5)
print(f"area_m2 {area_m2} p_max_kPa {p_max/1000:.1f} p_grip_kPa {p_grip/1000:.1f} F_needed_N {F_needed:.1f}")
